name: Pathoparalysis Mine
effect:
3/Scene, you can deploy a mine anywhere within Sensor range.

Whenever a hostile character gets within Burst 2, the mine explodes.
This will leave behind a Burst 2 cloud that whenever a biological character comes within, they gain the Pathoparalysis Status.

name: Neurax Worm
description: Unlike traditional system hacking, the Neurax Worm physically launches from the mech and burrows into the Target. This causes physical damage to the mech during this process as it attempts to take over.

actions.name: Launch Neurax Worm
actions.detail:
The Target must perform a Hull save and a Systems save.

If the Hull save fails, the Target takes 1d4 Kinetic damage that is considered Armor Piercing (AP).
If the Systems save fails, the Target takes 2 Heat.

name: Stucry
description: Stucry, an advanced virus designed to cause the Target's systems to start misbehaving and misfiring.

actions.name: Launch Stucry
actions.detail: Upon success, the Target fires with a random weapon chosen by the GM at a random character within range of said weapon. If there is not a valid Target for any of their weapons, then they fire upon themselves with a random weapon chosen by the GM.

name: CyWire
description: CyWire, a virus meant to cause havoc on a Target mech by rewiring parts of the mech.

actions.name: Launch CyWire
actions.detail:
Upon success, you may choose two mech stats of your Target (Hull, Agility, Systems, Engineering). The values of these two stats are swapped until the end of your next turn.

You cannot use this on a Target already suffering from this attack.
